title: Tight-binding eigenstates for full surface model
action: Solve the tight-binding Hamiltonian for an 8-layer fcc(001) slab using the defect-matrix method with full surface-state parameters: surface on-site shift -0.68 eV, Gaussian decay α_s=0.21 for surface layers and α=0.27 for interior layers. Use a one-orbital s-type model with half-filled band of width W=4.35 eV and nearest-neighbour overlap <a|H|a'> = -0.272 eV. Sample the 2D Brillouin zone uniformly with grid spacing 1/256 in reduced units. Save the eigen-energies and wavefunction coefficients.
description: Compute electronic structure for the full surface model.

title: Form factors A_s for full model
action: Compute the generalized density wave form factors A_s(q+G;z) using Gaussian Wannier functions with decay parameters α_s=0.21 for surface layers and α=0.27 for interior layers. Use a one-site overlap approximation and the fixed wavevector q = (π/32, 0).
description: Compute form factors needed for the separable representation.

title: Polarizability matrix N (full model)
action: Construct the proper polarizability matrix N_{ss'}(q) by performing a k-space integration over the 2D Brillouin zone using occupation numbers (Fermi level at half-filling) and the energies/coefficients from step 1. The wavevector is q = (π/32, 0).
description: Build the non-interacting polarizability matrix for the full model.

title: Density-interaction matrix V (full model)
action: Compute the density-interaction matrix V_{ss'}(q) by integrating the form factors A_s over the perpendicular coordinates z and z' with the 2D Fourier transform of the Coulomb interaction. Sum over reciprocal lattice vectors G as required.
description: Build the Coulomb-mediated interaction matrix for the full model.

title: Induced charge density profiles (full model)
action: Using N, V, and the form factors, form S = N(1 - V N)^{-1} and compute the induced charge density ρ^{ind}(z) for each layer under an external perturbation V_ext = δ(z-R_z(n)) e^{i q r}, with n=0 (surface layer) and n=1 (second layer). Retain the layer-resolved densities for both perturbation positions.
description: Compute induced density profiles for the full surface model.

title: Tight-binding eigenstates for geometric-only model
action: Repeat the tight-binding solve of step 1 but with surface-state effects turned off: set surface on-site shift to zero, η=0, ζ=0, and use the same decay parameter α_s=α=0.27 for all layers. Keep all other bulk parameters identical. Save the eigen-energies and wavefunction coefficients.
description: Compute electronic structure for the geometric-only model.

title: Form factors A_s for geometric-only model
action: Recompute form factors A_s using the geometric-only Wannier functions (α=0.27 for all layers) and the same one-site overlap and wavevector q = (π/32, 0).
description: Compute form factors for the geometric-only model.

title: Polarizability matrix N (geometric-only)
action: Reconstruct the proper polarizability matrix N_{ss'}(q) using the geometric-only eigenstates and the same k-space integration procedure.
description: Build the non-interacting polarizability matrix for the geometric-only model.

title: Density-interaction matrix V (geometric-only)
action: Reconstruct the density-interaction matrix V_{ss'}(q) using the geometric-only form factors.
description: Build the Coulomb-mediated interaction matrix for the geometric-only model.

title: Induced charge density profiles (geometric-only)
action: Compute the induced charge densities ρ^{ind}(z) for perturbations at n=0 and n=1 using the geometric-only N, V, and form factors, analogous to step 5.
description: Compute induced density profiles for the geometric-only model.

title: Write scored CSV
action: Assemble the four induced charge density profiles (geometric and full for n=0 and n=1) into a CSV file `induced_density.csv`. Normalise the profiles to a relative scale comparable to the paper's Fig. 1. The CSV must have 8 rows (layers 0-7) and columns: `layer` (int), `rho_geo_n0` (float), `rho_full_n0` (float), `rho_geo_n1` (float), `rho_full_n1` (float).
description: Final scored artifact containing layer-resolved induced charge densities for all four scenarios.
output_schema: 8 rows, columns: layer (int), rho_geo_n0 (float), rho_full_n0 (float), rho_geo_n1 (float), rho_full_n1 (float)
